description: Remove one company from one of the person's StockLens portfolios. Call it only when the person has asked for it. Without portfolio_id or portfolio_name it removes from the default portfolio, and the result names the portfolio. Relay the result's message. A status other than removed is an answer, not an error. A holding with recorded transactions is not removed here; the result says where to do it. One ticker per call. It does not trade or delete transactions.

exchange.description: Exchange code (e.g. NASDAQ). Optional. When omitted, the ticker is matched against the portfolio; if it is there on more than one exchange you will be asked which.

portfolio_id.description: The id of the portfolio to remove from, as get_portfolio_insights lists it. Optional: without it or portfolio_name the default portfolio is used.

portfolio_name.description: The name of the portfolio to remove from, as the person names it (exact, case does not matter). Optional.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL). Exactly one ticker per call.

name: remove_from_watchlist
title: Remove from Portfolio
